newsitem.title: FRANCE: French workers to protest Akzo layoffs.
newsitem.headline: French workers to protest Akzo layoffs.

text.p: Workers at the RETI drugs company of Riom in the French Auvergne region are planning to travel to Arnhem in the Netherlands to protest on Saturday against planned layoffs by the Akzo Nobel NV chemical group.

"We will leave with eight coaches on Friday evening and we expect to march with 350 to 400 people to the Akzo headquarters in the early afternoon," a spokeswoman for the RETI labour unions told Reuters on Wednesday.
"We will be joined by several mayors of towns in our region, who will be wearing their tricoloured sashes, as well as the member of parliament for the region," she added.

The RETI workers are protesting against a restructuring plan by Akzo which would lead to 110 job losses in the Auvergne region. Akzo wants to halt research activities at RETI and transfer the headquarters to Paris.
"We want the company to review its plans. RETI is profitable," the spokeswoman said.
In a statement the unions said they were going to protest in the Netherlands to "hit what counts most for the company -- its brand image."
